title: Profile setup
description: Full-viewport profile setup screen composing the form-layout block and the Avatar primitive: a photo to upload or remove, then the profile fields, with the photo's uploading, error and empty states and the form's error, loading and disabled states. Presentational — data and callbacks in, no navigation state — and responsive to its container (@container) across the @sm and @md contract steps: the masthead and photo row line up at @sm, the title grows and the footer lines up at @md.
